edits.before: Q poke is your only level-1 tool — chain it on his step-ups but don't force anything; your power arrives with levels.
edits.after: Inner Flame outranges your 775 Q and refunds Mantra off every hit — last-hit at max range and take no free poke.

edits.before: W online — the burst-heal turns even trades into wins. Take the extended trade only when his answer is down.
edits.after: Focused Resolve lands before your E hook — she tethers your W-lunge and walks out while the root ticks. Wait.

edits.before: Weave passive autos between every spell. Trade around Focused Resolve (Tether) and bank small HP leads — they compound at 6.
edits.after: Her Mantra is back every few waves and roots your engage — only step up when you have seen it spent, then weave passive autos.

edits.before: Riftmaker spike — your full chain with the W heal wins almost any extended 1v1 that starts even.
edits.after: Riftmaker plus the W heal wins extended 1v1s, but her E shield and move speed keep the duel honest.

edits.before: - Karma Focused Resolve (Tether): matchup-defining — The root tether — break it with range or line of sight. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E1 shield for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Karma Focused Resolve (Tether): matchup-defining — flat 12s at every rank; break the tether with terrain or 675 range, and commit in that window. Mantra returns every 40/38/36/34s and Gathering Fire shortens it — count her casts.

edits.before: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. First: Riftmaker into Mercs or Steelcaps; then Zhonya's and Cosmic Drive. Abyssal Mask vs AP.
edits.after: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. First: Riftmaker into Mercs; Oblivion Orb early — Mantra W heals her through your chip. Then Zhonya's.
